text:
emily.chen: Heads-up — ran DAST on staging and noticed several authz failures correlated with SAST findings in the same PRs. The DAST proxy logs show KMS decrypt errors around 12:03 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern before?

mike.patel: hmm — can you paste the exact log lines? sounds like ephemeral creds or RBAC drift.

emily.chen: pasted: 
```
2026-03-18T12:03:14Z proxy.go:87 error: kms: decrypt failed: AccessDenied
request_id=abc123 branch=feature/checkout-rewrite
```
Also DAST tool reported login-failure + missing session cookie on /checkout endpoint.

ara: AccessDenied from KMS usually means service-account role lost kms:Decrypt permission. Any recent RBAC policy change?

samir: I rotated a service account last week for CI runners — but that was only for build-clusters. Did we update GCP IAM for staging proxy?

emily.chen: Not that I know. CI logs show the proxy used `infra-dast-sa@redwood-prod` — maybe it's pointed to the wrong project.

devops-bot: [deploy] staging-proxy rolled at 2026-03-17T22:10 UTC by deploy/github-action #4052 :thumbsup:

mike.patel: Ok — two parallel issues: (1) DAST failing auth because proxy can't decrypt session key; (2) SAST flags in same PR maybe friction. We need evidence correlation: link findings -> commits -> runtime logs.

emily.chen: I started a quick grep and found stack traces referencing `keystore:staging/proxy` and commit 9f7a2b. I can attach the eval set.

ara: Can you run `gcloud iam roles list --project=staging-project` and check if `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` is bound to `infra-dast-sa`? If not, add it temporarily and test.

samir: I'll check. if role missing, we should NOT grant globally; prefer a least-priv scoped grant to the key resource. Also need audit log proof for the change.

emily.chen: I ran `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` output shows no binding for infra-dast-sa.

mike.patel: That's the problem. Who removed it? Check audit logs: `resource.type="k8s_container" protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"` around 2026-03-16.

ara: I'm seeing an approval from `ops-automation` removing a service account as part of "clean up stale grants" PR — forgot to list keystore. Oof.

emily.chen: For immediate mitigation, can someone add back a scoped binding to the key? I'll re-run DAST afterwards.

samir: I'll open a quick PR to add the binding with audit annotation and runbook note. tag @emily.chen @mike.patel

devops-bot: PR #4821 created by samir — `infra: add kms grant for infra-dast-sa (staging)` [link]

mike.patel: After we restore, we should map DAST session failures to SAST findings based on the PR sha so security reviewers don't chase unrelated flakes. Proposal: add a correlation label `sdlc-evidence:<pr-sha>` into the DAST report json and surface it in Console.

ara: Love that. Also add a rule in premerge checklist: "verify keystore grants are included in infra cleanup PRs" and require a changelog entry in the PR body.

emily.chen: Re-run succeeded after grant — DAST auth passed for /checkout. SAST findings still exist; I'll follow up with the PR authors to triage.

mike.patel: Action items: (1) samir — finish PR and include audit note (due 3/19). (2) emily — attach correlated evidence (logs+DAST JSON+SAST report) to the ticket. (3) ara — add premerge checklist item and quick runbook snippet for RBAC->KMS flip.

emily.chen: filing ticket now and will cc security-oncall. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
